caption: The image depicts a drawing of a wooden cabinet placed centrally on a light beige background. The cabinet has a rectangular shape with two main parts: the upper section consists of two open shelves with scalloped, decorative edges, and the lower section features a single closed door with a visible hinge and knob. The wood grain is distinctly illustrated, showing variations in tone from light to medium brown, giving it a textured and realistic appearance. The cabinet stands on a broad, solid base, and its top is defined by a slightly protruding cornice. The shadows cast to the left and slightly behind the cabinet suggest a light source from the front, right side. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Irving I.
